name: @proworks-hub/invoiceiq
description: InvoiceIQ — invoice capture and matching where the type carries the honesty rule: a two-way result has no goods-receipt field to read, a skipped check can never produce matched, tolerance schemes refuse unconfigured dimensions as infinite, duplicate detection computes at most review-required (a human confirms), and supersession never carries a prior approval forward.
author: Steven Kreutzer
